# @lacspace/cache

> 标签: async-cache, cache, cache-invalidation, cache-stats, cache-tags, dedupe, getorset, in-memory-cache, isomorphic, lfu, lru, lru-cache, memoization, memoize, single-flight, stale-while-revalidate, swr, ttl, typescript, zero-dependency

## 简介

A tiny in-memory cache — LRU/LFU eviction, per-entry TTL, stale-while-revalidate, tag invalidation and hit/miss stats, plus wrap()/getOrSet()/memoize() to cache any async function with single-flight de-duplication. Zero-dependency, isomorphic.
